Name: Recessed Fish Tank (SDV1.6)
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[size=4][quote][center]This mod is a conversion and modification to the FF and CP version of a mod that was previously released as a mod that works with DGA. (Repealed [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14673]DGA version﻿﻿[/url]﻿)[/center][/quote][/size][color=#ffff00][size=3]
There are a few changes from the old DGA version.
We ask that those who have previously used the DGA version also read the description.[/size][/color]

[color=#00ff00][size=4]In addition to "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿", "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458]Furniture Framework[/url]" and "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]" are also required mods.[/size][/color]


[color=#00ffff][size=5][center]This is a natural-looking recessed fish tank.[/center][/size][/color]
Each tank has three different looks. (See also IMAGES on the Mod page.)
[quote][color=#00ff00][size=4]Type: High[/size][/color] ... Standard recessed fish tank.
[color=#00ff00][size=4]Type: High (NoBackground)[/size][/color] ... The background of the usual “Tyep: High” is not present, so that the back of the installation can be seen.
By showing the windows, wall furniture, and wallpaper on the back wall, you can create a more stylish interior.
[color=#00ff00][size=4]Type: Low[/size][/color] ... This version has no wood planks and a larger area for fish to see and swim.
[color=#00ff00][size=4]Type: Low (NoBackground)[/size][/color] ... Version without background.[/quote]
Some fish tanks, long pillars and dedicated catalogs are available at Willy's shop.
An dedicated catalog is required to obtain all items.
The appearance of the catalog, the amount of money, and the items displayed can be changed in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]ModConfig[/url].
Long pillars with banners are also available at each festival shop.
(There are currently nine types of long pillars in all.)

A “transparent fish tank,” a byproduct of the mod creation process, is also included in the package.
This could be used in a variety of ways, so try it out!
(The tank is displayed on the toolbar with a glass-like appearance for clarity. Note that it is completely transparent when installed, and if you do not have fish in it, you may not be able to tell where it is located.)

Currently, you can choose the color of the fish tank frame from the original “Black, Blue, Gray” and...
There are colors that correspond to the recolor mod.
Currently, the supported mods that can set the color are...
 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6098]Rustic Country Town Interior[/url]
 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url]
 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]Starblue Valley World Recolor
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24533]Beams Color Change[/url] (White)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790]DaisyNiko's Earthy Interiors[/url]
(These mods can use their colors even if they are not installed.)

[color=#ffff00][size=6]*** Notes!! *** [/size][size=5](Updated in v1.8)[/size][/color]
Notes on playing games in non-English languages.
[size=2]Currently, an error message appears when returning to the title screen after loading saved data while using a language other than English.
Also, if the saved data is loaded again with this error message displayed, the game crashes.
We believe that this is a problem caused by the “[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458]Furniture Framework[/url]﻿” and are currently asking its author to investigate.
[/size]
[color=#00ffff]How to change the color of the fish tank frame.[/color]
The method of changing the color of the aquarium has been changed since v1.8.
The new tank color change section has been moved into "[color=#00ff00][CP] Recessed Fish Tank[/color]" in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]ModConfig[/url].

You can now change the color of the tank by changing the settings just like any other CP Mod.
With this change, the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]ModConfig[/url] settings for the "[color=#00ff00][FF] Recessed Fish Tank[/color]" only have an On/Off item for the fundamental item, which should not be changed. Do not change this setting, as unintentional disabling of items may result in unexpected errors.

[color=#00ff00][size=3]Note.[/size][/color]
Notice to those who have been using the DGA version.
It is no longer possible to change the color of each fish tank individually, which was possible in the DGA version.
This may become possible in a future update of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458]Furniture Framework[/url].

[color=#00ff00][size=4]Compatibility with other mods.[/size][/color]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url]
If installed, the “Happy Home Designer” furniture installation UI is available by accessing the dedicated catalog.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24658]TV with Stand (SDV1.6)[/url]
Compatibility...not exactly, but this mod was created as a derivative mod in the process of creating RFT. Please use it if you are interested as it looks great with long pillars.


Currently supported in English and Japanese.
